# Retention Index Calculations

Retention indexes are calculated by using the retention time of alkanes that proceed directly before and after the compound.The equation is as follows

> Ix = 100n + 100(tx-tn) / (tn+1 − tn)

The package I would like to use for this is: chemhelper by Eric R. Scott

To cite package ‘chemhelper’ in publications use:

Scott E (2023). chemhelper: Helper Functions For Dealing With GCMS and LCMS data from IonAnalytics. R package version 0.0.0.9000, https://github.com/aariq/chemhelper.

Testing one retention index and comparing it to hand calculation
```{r}
calc_RI(8.551333, nrt$rt, nrt$carbon_num)

#my hand calculation resulted in 884.6
```

```{r}
f4hr_p14_tic_ri <- f4hr_p14_tic |>
  mutate(ri = calc_RI(RetentionTime, nrt$rt, nrt$carbon_num))
```

> 38 of the compounds fell outside the alkane range and were mathematically extrapolated using the chemhelper function.

```{r}
f4hr_p14_ri <- f4hr_p14 |>
  mutate(ri = calc_RI(RetentionTime, nrt$rt, nrt$carbon_num))
```

> 16 of the compounds fell outside the alkane range and were mathematically extrapolated using the chemhelper function.

#Testing webchem
```{r}
CASs <- c("83-34-1", "119-36-8", "123-35-3", "19700-21-1")

RIs <-
  nist_ri(
    query = CASs,
    from = "cas",
    type = "linear",
    polarity = "non-polar",
    temp_prog = "ramp"
  )
head(RIs)

library(stringr)
RIs_filtered <-
  RIs %>%
  filter(gas == "Helium",
         between(length, 20, 30),
         str_detect(phase, "5"),
         diameter < 0.3,
         thickness == 0.25) %>% 
  rename(CAS = query)
head(RIs_filtered)

RIs_filtered %>% 
  group_by(CAS) %>% 
  summarise(mean_RI = mean(RI))

best_RIs <-
  RIs_filtered %>%
  group_by(CAS) %>% 
  filter(RI == median(RI)) %>% 
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>% 
  select(CAS, RI, reference)
best_RIs

cir_query("o-Xylene", "cas")
```

# Reading in all the files and getting the average experimental ri for each compound
```{r}
# makes list of files in this folder matching naming scheme
files <- list.files(
  "forest_untargeted_results",
  pattern = "_(qic|tic)\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE)

# reading in alkane mix
nrt <- read.xlsx("Alkane_RT_fto.xlsx")

#running function on all files to organize and rename them
all_peaks <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {

  read.xlsx(f, "Sheet2", na.strings = "n.a.") |>
    slice(-n()) |>
    mutate(
      ri = calc_RI(RetentionTime, nrt$rt, nrt$carbon_num),
      file = basename(f),
      sample_id = str_remove(basename(f), "_(qic|tic)\\.xlsx$"),
      file_type = str_extract(basename(f), "(?<=_)(qic|tic)(?=\\.xlsx)")
    )
})

#did a sanity check on the amount of observations and it checks out :)
```

# filtering out blanks
```{r}
# compounds found in blanks
blank_peaks <- all_peaks |>
  filter(str_detect(sample_id, "blk")) |>
  distinct(Peakname)

# keep only compounds not found in blanks
sample_peaks <- all_peaks |>
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "blk")) |>
  anti_join(blank_peaks, by = "Peakname")
```

# filter out tic -> grouping by sample_id and peak name -> summarizing retention index
```{r}
avg_ri_all <- 
  sample_peaks |>
  filter_out(file_type == "tic") |>
  group_by(sample_id, Peakname) |>
  summarise(avg_ri = mean(ri),
            n = n(),
            CAS = first(CAS),
            avg_area = mean(Area))

#exporting one file to do manual retention index checks on just to see how far off left field we are
f4hr_ri_p9_ri <- avg_ri_all |>
  filter(sample_id == "forest4hr_p9")

write_xlsx(f4hr_ri_p9_ri, "forest_pump9_ri_check.xlsx")

#list of unique compounds
unique_compounds <- sample_peaks |>
  distinct(Peakname)
#found 190 unique compounds after blank subtraction
```
